text:
Roberta Zuliani They are not taking DNA samples at the border - how would they possibly know?  Unless they have told someone. They ask simple questions why you are coming to Israel - How long for - Where will you be staying - Do you have family or friends in Israel
That’s about it
If one falls out with their family and doesn't talk to them does that mean they can’t enter the country and need to declare their family history because they want to have a holiday in Tel Aviv?
If they are coming as illegal immigration then Its likely they will be caught out at the airport - there are ways of knowing - but if they are genuinely coming just for a visit then what is the issue?
